use_cases: Displaying images with custom SVG masks for unique visual shapes
Creating branded image containers with irregular boundaries
Adding visual interest to hero or feature image sections
Building creative portfolio or gallery layouts with masked images
Implementing distinctive image presentations in marketing pages
ai_summary: A React image component featuring CSS SVG masking to display images in custom geometric shapes. The component applies a tomato-colored background with a complex SVG path mask, creating an irregular image container effect. Includes hover scale animation for interactive engagement. Designed for creative image presentation in design-forward layouts.
